title: AppLovin takes legal action against Unity over Ad Quality SDK
summary: AppLovin has taken legal action against Unity over data collected through the latter’s Ad Quality SDK. As first reported by Digiday, AppLovin has applied for a temporary restraining order in California seeking to prevent Unity from collecting and using certain data relating to its advertising business. ... title: Impact46's Eric Husny: "The ecosystem today is simply much more investable than it was a few years ago"
summary: Saudi Arabia’s games industry continues to grow rapidly and Impact46 has become a major investor in the sector, with 16 gaming investments to date and a focus on backing companies that can build sustainable businesses. The firm's recent $53 million-plus investment in Kammelna, one of its largest gaming deals to date, demonstrates the scale of its ambitions in the sector. ... [ MORE ]

title: GCAP 2026: Alanah Pearce, Housemarque and Mixtape developers to headline Melbourne conference
summary: Games Connect Asia Pacific (GCAP) will return to Melbourne from 5–7 October 2026, marking the conference’s 20th anniversary. Organized by the Interactive Games & Entertainment Association (IGEA), the event will bring together game developers, studios, publishers and other interactive entertainment professionals from Australia and around the world during Melbourne International Games Week.

title: Ubisoft brings Creative House 2 together under Massive Entertainment
summary: Ubisoft has brought the teams behind The Division, Ghost Recon, and Splinter Cell together under the Massive Entertainment brand. Following Christoph Hartmann’s appointment as general manager of Creative House 2 earlier this year, development in Montréal, Paris, Sweden and Toronto will now operate under the shared Massive Entertainment name. ...
